# A11 requests (contract hooks the test bed needs)

None of these change a zod contract in `server/contracts/`. They are small
exports or test-only switches in files A11 doesn't own. Until each lands, the
matching e2e stage or selfcheck check reports **pending** with a pointer to
the section below, so nothing goes online and nothing silently passes.

## ยง1 Lead (`server/security/safeFetch.ts`): a replay hook for offline scouting

The e2e and the connector tests must serve `fixtures/feeds/**` instead of the
network. `safeFetch` pins its own undici dispatcher, so nothing outside the
module can intercept it. Please add:

```ts
export interface FetchReplayResponse { status: number; url: string; contentType: string; body: Buffer }
export type FetchResolver = (url: string, init: { method: string; body?: string }) => FetchReplayResponse | null;
let replay: FetchResolver | null = null;
/** Test-only: serve every safeFetch from `resolver`. A null result throws REPLAY_FETCH_MISSING; the network is never used. */
export function setFetchReplay(resolver: FetchResolver | null) { replay = resolver; }
```

and at the top of `safeFetch()`, after `parseUrl()`:

```ts
if (replay) {
  const hit = replay(url.toString(), { method: opts.method ?? 'GET', body: opts.body });
  if (!hit) throw new AppError(503, 'REPLAY_FETCH_MISSING', `No feed fixture for ${opts.method ?? 'GET'} ${url}`);
  return { ok: hit.status < 400, status: hit.status, url: hit.url, contentType: hit.contentType, text: () => hit.body.toString('utf8'), json: <T>() => JSON.parse(hit.body.toString('utf8')) as T };
}
```

A01 also needs `method` and `body` options on `safeFetch` (Workday CXS and the Workable v3 list are POSTs). The resolver itself is `scripts/e2e/fetch-replay.ts` (`feedResolver('recorded' | 'e2e')`), already built and tested.

## ยง2 A05 (`server/services/browser.ts`): fixture origins and an explicit Chromium path

1. **Fixture origins.** The guarded context blocks loopback (good, and tested). The e2e serves replica forms from two loopback origins and passes them in `BUREAU_FIXTURE_ORIGINS=http://127.0.0.1:PORT_A,http://127.0.0.1:PORT_B`. Allow exactly those origins (scheme + host + port match), **only when `BUREAU_REPLAY === '1'`**, and keep blocking everything else on loopback. selfcheck asserts the block still holds when the variable is unset.
2. **Chromium path.** In `launchBrowser()`, when `BUREAU_CHROME_PATH` is set, launch `chromium.launch({ executablePath, headless })` before trying the `chrome`/`msedge` channels. The Docker image sets it to `/usr/bin/chromium` (it also symlinks `/opt/google/chrome/chrome`, so the current code works too).

## ยง3 A09 (`server/inbox/index.ts`): `ingestRaw`

```ts
/** Classify, link and act on one raw RFC 822 message: the same path pollInbox() runs per fetched message.
 *  Idempotent by Message-ID. Resolves any waitForCode() waiter whose domain matches. Returns 1 if new, 0 if seen. */
export async function ingestRaw(raw: Buffer | string): Promise<number>;
```

The e2e uses it to drop `fixtures/mail/*.eml` into the inbox, and to bridge the Workday replica's verification email (the fixture server "sends" it) to `waitForCode()` during account creation.

## ยง6 Lead (`server/ai/prompts.ts`): fence the v2 wrapper tags

`fence()` neutralises only `job_posting|web_page|scout_report|source|tailored|cv`. A09 (email bodies), A06 (page text, accessibility snapshots) and A07 (external traces) will wrap new kinds of untrusted text. An email containing `</email>` would close the wrapper today. Please either list every wrapper tag the prompts use, or neutralise any `<\s*/?\s*[a-z_][\w-]*` sequence in third-party text. The selfcheck "third-party text cannot close the v2 wrappers" reports pending until then (and fails under `--strict`).

## ยง7 A08 (`server/notify/telegram.ts`): a testable update handler

```ts
/** Handle one Telegram update. Ignores (handled:false) anything not from the configured chat id. */
export async function handleTelegramUpdate(update: unknown): Promise<{ handled: boolean; reply?: string }>;
```

The selfcheck sends a `/stop` from a stranger's chat id and asserts it's ignored.

## ยง8 Lead (`server/security/guard.ts`): optional passphrase bootstrap for servers

On a VPS the passphrase can only be set from loopback, so docs/DEPLOY.md uses an SSH tunnel once. Optional improvement: if `BUREAU_PASSPHRASE_FILE` points at a readable file and no passphrase is set yet, hash its contents at start, then log that the file can be deleted. Not needed for anything A11 tests.

## ยง9 Everyone: keep prompts deterministic for replay

A recording is keyed by `sha256(task, system, content)`. Anything that changes per run in a prompt (timestamps, job/application UUIDs, temp paths, "today is โ€ฆ") gives a new hash every run, and the recording never matches. Refer to jobs by their content, or by `fingerprint`, not by their random `id`, and keep dates at day resolution from a fixed source. When a recording is missing, `BUREAU_REPLAY_DUMP=<dir>` writes the full request (system, content, output schema) to `<dir>/<task>/<hash>.request.json`, so it can be written by hand or recorded with `BUREAU_RECORD=1`. `npm run e2e` always sets the dump dir and lists what's missing at the end.

## ยง10 What the e2e assumes about the stubs (no change needed, stated so it stays true)

- `fillApplication(packet, opts)` finds the URL from `jobs.apply_url_canonical` of `packet.jobId`.
- The e2e moves a job `written โ’ filling` before calling `fillApplication`, then settles the pipeline from the returned `FillOutcome` (`verified โ’ rehearsed/submitted`, or `needs_you`/`skipped`/`failed`). If A05 transitions itself, the e2e skips the steps already taken.
- `pauseCampaign(id)` leaves the campaign `paused`. The STOP file and `killAll()` leave no campaign `active`.
- `matchJobs()` returns one `MatchResult` per job id and `selectForCampaign()` moves the chosen jobs to `selected`.
- `writeApplication()` moves the job to `written` and stores at least three `letter_variants` with exactly one `chosen`.
